The three bugs are exactly the kind of thing a fresh session needs to know NOT to reintroduce - especially the ?render=1 gating, since it's easy to imagine a future change to handleContent() re-coupling rendering behavior to the bare route without realizing families export/lavish depend on that route staying pristine.
